title: Sturmian beta-shifts do not have typical periodic optimization
summary: A shift space is said to have typical periodic optimization (TPO) if the set of Lipschitz functions whose unique maximizing measure is supported on a periodic orbit contains an open dense subset of the space of Lipschitz functions. We show that beta-shifts whose lexicographically largest point is a Sturmian sequence do not have TPO: on each such beta-shift there is a non-empty open set of Lipschitz functions, all of which have the Sturmian measure as their unique maximizing measure.
